papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心阻力训练被认为是提高成人肌肉力量和爆发力指标的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不清楚。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向）的影响。方法 检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原创期刊文章，这些文章均来自电子搜索引擎。

papers.title_en: The Biomechanical Influence of Step Width on Typical Locomotor Activities: A Systematic Review
papers.title_zh: 步宽对典型运动活动生物力学影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: A systematic review of published findings to determine the influence of acute changes in step width on locomotion biomechanics and provide implications for injury prevention and enhanced sports performance found that increasing step width may be beneficial for specific injury rehabilitation.
papers.abstract_en: Step width is a spatial variable in the frontal plane, defined as the mediolateral distance between the heel (forefoot during sprinting) of bilateral feet at initial contact. Variations in step width may impact the lower limb biomechanics. This systematic review aimed to synthesize the published findings to determine the influence of acute changes in step width on locomotion biomechanics and provide implications for injury prevention and enhanced sports performance. Literature was identified, selected, and appraised in accordance with the methods of a systematic review. Four electronic databases (Web of Science, MEDLINE via PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect) were searched up until May 2023 with the development of inclusion criteria based on the PICO model. papers.abstract_zh: 步宽是额状面上的一个空间变量，定义为双脚初始接触时脚跟（冲刺时为前脚掌）之间的内外侧距离。步宽的变化可能会影响下肢生物力学。本系统综述旨在综合已发表的研究结果，以确定步宽急性变化对运动生物力学的影响，并为损伤预防和运动表现提升提供启示。文献的识别、筛选和评估均按照系统综述的方法进行。检索了四个电子数据库。

papers.title_en: Nutritional Strategies in the Rehabilitation of Musculoskeletal Injuries in Athletes: A Systematic Integrative Review
papers.title_zh: 运动员肌肉骨骼损伤康复中的营养策略：一项系统整合综述
papers.tldr_en: Based on the main findings of the selected studies, nutritional strategies that benefit the rehabilitation process in injured athletes include balanced energy intake, and a high-protein and carbohydrate-rich diet.
papers.abstract_en: It is estimated that three to five million sports injuries occur worldwide each year. The highest incidence is reported during competition periods with mainly affectation of the musculoskeletal tissue. For appropriate nutritional management and correct use of nutritional supplements, it is important to individualize based on clinical effects and know the adaptive response during the rehabilitation phase after a sports injury in athletes. Therefore, the aim of this PRISMA in Exercise, Rehabilitation, Sport Medicine and Sports Science PERSiST-based systematic integrative review was to perform an update on nutritional strategies during the rehabilitation phase of musculoskeletal injuries in elite athletes. papers.abstract_zh: 据估计，全球每年发生三到五百万例运动损伤。发病率最高的是在比赛期间，主要累及肌肉骨骼组织。为了进行适当的营养管理和正确使用营养补充剂，根据临床效果进行个体化并了解运动员运动损伤康复期的适应性反应至关重要。因此，本篇基于运动、康复、运动医学和运动科学PRISMA PERSiST的系统整合综述旨在进行一次全面的评估。

papers.title_en: What Is "Zone 2 Training"?: Experts' Viewpoint on Definition, Training Methods, and Expected Adaptations.
papers.title_zh: 什么是“2区训练”？：专家关于定义、训练方法和预期适应的观点
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.tldr_en: This commentary provides practical insight and unified criteria regarding the preferred intensity, duration, and session type for the optimization of zone 2 training based on the perspectives of acknowledged sport scientists and professional coaches.
papers.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
The role of high-volume low-intensity training for enhancing endurance performance has gained growing interest in recent years. Specifically, so-called "zone 2 training" is currently receiving much attention, and many propose that this is the target intensity at which a large proportion of total endurance training should be performed. However, despite the popularity of this concept, there is no clear consensus among coaches, athletes, and scientists regarding the definition of zone 2 training.


PURPOSE
This commentary summarizes the perspectives, experience, and knowledge of an expert panel of 14 applied sport scientists and professional coaches with the aim of providing insight and a basis for definitional consensus on zone 2 training. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 近年来，大容量低强度训练在提高耐力表现方面的作用受到越来越多的关注。具体而言，所谓的“2区训练”目前备受瞩目，许多人认为这是总耐力训练中大部分训练应达到的目标强度。然而，尽管这一概念广受欢迎，但教练、运动员和科学家之间对于2区训练的定义尚未达成明确共识。目的 本述评总结了一位专家关于“2区训练”的观点、经验和知识。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 可穿戴传感器步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：一项针对损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。虽然传统的实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态学有效环境下进行客观、实时步态评估提供了新的机遇。本系统综述旨在（1）评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床有效性；（2）考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用；以及（3）识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 撰写高质量运动科学案例研究
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. Third, they should be well structured and engagingl
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 运动生理学和运动表现研究通常依赖于比较实验组与对照组和/或干预前与干预后结果的群体设计。本述评强调了高质量案例研究的关键要素，并为《国际运动生理学与表现杂志》的读者和作者提供了明确的指导原则。我们提出了4个基本要素。首先，案例研究应通过解决新颖问题和明确目的来提供相关且原创的见解。其次，它们必须采用严谨的方法学，包括细致的参与。
